name: takegraph
description: Agent-native, voice-first video editing with reviewable patches.

scripts.build: pnpm build:view && pnpm build:mcp && cargo build --workspace
scripts.check: pnpm -r check && cargo fmt --all -- --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings
scripts.spec:run: quint run --max-samples=1000 --invariant=safety specs/protocols/patch_protocol.qnt && quint run --main=ymm4ApplyProtocol --max-samples=1000 --invariant=safety specs/protocols/ymm4_apply_protocol.qnt && quint run --main=ymm4LifecycleProtocol --max-samples=1000 --invariant=lifecycleSafety specs/protocols/ymm4_apply_protocol.qnt && quint run --main=ymm4ReconciliationProtocol --max-samples=1000 --invariant=reconciliationSafety specs/protocols/ymm4_apply_protocol.qnt && quint run --main=ymm4ExternalMutationFenceProtocol --max-samples=1000 --invariant=externalMutationFenceSafety specs/protocols/ymm4_apply_protocol.qnt && quint run --main=ymm4ProjectInitializationProtocol --max-samples=1000 --invariant=initializationSafety specs/protocols/ymm4_project_initialization_protocol.qnt && quint test --main=ymm4ProjectInitializationProtocol --max-samples=1000 specs/protocols/ymm4_project_initialization_protocol.qnt && quint run --main=agentReportProtocol --max-samples=1000 --invariant=safety specs/protocols/agent_report_protocol.qnt && quint run --main=ymm4ChangeSetProtocol --max-samples=1000 --invariant=changeSetSafety specs/protocols/ymm4_change_set_protocol.qnt && quint test --main=ymm4ChangeSetProtocol --max-samples=1000 specs/protocols/ymm4_change_set_protocol.qnt && npm run spec:edit-contracts
scripts.spec:change-set: quint typecheck specs/protocols/ymm4_change_set_protocol.qnt && quint run --main=ymm4ChangeSetProtocol --max-samples=1000 --invariant=changeSetSafety specs/protocols/ymm4_change_set_protocol.qnt && quint test --main=ymm4ChangeSetProtocol --max-samples=1000 specs/protocols/ymm4_change_set_protocol.qnt
scripts.spec:edit-contracts: quint typecheck specs/protocols/ymm4_edit_surface_protocol.qnt && quint typecheck specs/protocols/ymm4_composition_graph_protocol.qnt && quint typecheck specs/protocols/ymm4_project_edit_protocol.qnt && quint typecheck specs/protocols/ymm4_edit_transaction_protocol.qnt && quint typecheck specs/protocols/ymm4_native_voice_text_protocol.qnt && quint run --main=ymm4EditSurfaceProtocol --max-samples=1000 --invariant=editSurfaceSafety --verbosity=1 specs/protocols/ymm4_edit_surface_protocol.qnt && quint test --main=ymm4EditSurfaceProtocol --max-samples=1000 specs/protocols/ymm4_edit_surface_protocol.qnt && quint run --main=ymm4CompositionGraphProtocol --max-samples=1000 --invariant=compositionGraphSafety --verbosity=1 specs/protocols/ymm4_composition_graph_protocol.qnt && quint test --main=ymm4CompositionGraphProtocol --max-samples=1000 specs/protocols/ymm4_composition_graph_protocol.qnt && quint run --main=ymm4ProjectEditProtocol --max-samples=1000 --invariant=projectEditSafety --verbosity=1 specs/protocols/ymm4_project_edit_protocol.qnt && quint test --main=ymm4ProjectEditProtocol --max-samples=1000 specs/protocols/ymm4_project_edit_protocol.qnt && quint run --main=ymm4EditTransactionProtocol --max-samples=1000 --invariant=editTransactionSafety --verbosity=1 specs/protocols/ymm4_edit_transaction_protocol.qnt && quint test --main=ymm4EditTransactionProtocol --max-samples=1000 specs/protocols/ymm4_edit_transaction_protocol.qnt && quint run --main=ymm4NativeVoiceTextProtocol --max-samples=1000 --invariant=nativeVoiceTextSafety --verbosity=1 specs/protocols/ymm4_native_voice_text_protocol.qnt && quint test --main=ymm4NativeVoiceTextProtocol --max-samples=1000 specs/protocols/ymm4_native_voice_text_protocol.qnt
scripts.spec:typecheck: quint typecheck specs/protocols/patch_protocol.qnt && quint typecheck specs/protocols/ymm4_apply_protocol.qnt && quint typecheck specs/protocols/ymm4_project_initialization_protocol.qnt && quint typecheck specs/protocols/agent_report_protocol.qnt && quint typecheck specs/protocols/ymm4_change_set_protocol.qnt && quint typecheck specs/protocols/ymm4_edit_surface_protocol.qnt && quint typecheck specs/protocols/ymm4_composition_graph_protocol.qnt && quint typecheck specs/protocols/ymm4_project_edit_protocol.qnt && quint typecheck specs/protocols/ymm4_edit_transaction_protocol.qnt && quint typecheck specs/protocols/ymm4_native_voice_text_protocol.qnt
scripts.test: cargo build -p takegraph-cli && pnpm build:view && pnpm build:mcp && pnpm -r test && cargo test --workspace && pnpm test:bridge
scripts.verify: pnpm check && pnpm test && pnpm spec:typecheck && pnpm spec:run
